start.speaker: lyra
start.text: Hello? Oh, thank the stars, a person! Did you see the light from the Core last night? Everyone in town says it's impossible.

n2.speaker: lyra
n2.text: Wait. You're shaking. And that pendant is glowing. Are you all right?

choices.text: I don't remember anything. Not even how I got here.
I'm fine. What is the Core?

n3a.speaker: lyra
n3a.text: Nothing at all? That's terrifying. And, I'm sorry, also incredibly interesting. I'm Lyra. Lanternwright apprentice.

n3b.speaker: lyra
n3b.text: The Elyndra Core. That giant spire on the ridge. It's been dead for six hundred years, and last night it flickered. I'm Lyra, by the way.

n4.speaker: lyra
n4.text: Hold still. Your pendant is singing. Can you hear it? It sounds like wind through a bell.

n5.speaker: narrator
n5.text: A cool current rushes through you. The air around your hands begins to move. You can hear Zephyr.

n6.speaker: lyra
n6.text: You're a Resonant! Two tones at once, though? That shouldn't be possible. Come on, Elder Maren needs to see this. Vael Harrow is just up the road.

start.speaker: lyra
start.text: The Sanctum door is open. I can feel it humming from here. Whatever is inside has been waiting a very long time.

n2.speaker: lyra
n2.text: Keep your elements close. Fire to break its guard, wind to stay out of reach. And please don't die. I'd have to write that up.

start.speaker: lyra
start.text: You're back! The Core is brighter. You can see it from the plaza. What happened in there?

choices.text: The guardian fell. Its heart was singing the same note as my pendant.

n2.speaker: lyra
n2.text: Then the Choir records were right. The Cores aren't dead. They're asleep, and you're waking them.

n3.speaker: narrator
n3.text: Far up on the ridge, the Elyndra Core pulses once. Somewhere a voice you have never heard says, "Every light you kindle, something else must pay for."

n4.speaker: lyra
n4.text: Did you hear that too? Okay. Okay. We'll figure it out together. Here, take my charm. Lanternwrights look after their own.

start.speaker: lyra
start.text: I've filled half a journal on you already. Auralis has Choir ruins on the coast. When you're ready, I want to see them.

start.speaker: lyra
start.text: Did you know the Old Span is older than the town? Someone built a bridge to nowhere, and the town grew around it. Sorry. I do this.

start.speaker: maren
start.text: So you're the one Lyra won't stop talking about. You don't look like a portent.

n2.speaker: maren
n2.text: Two Resonances, no memory, waking the same night the Core stirs. I don't believe in coincidence.

choices.text: I want answers as much as you do.
I'm not a threat to your town.

n3.speaker: maren
n3.text: Good. Then we want the same thing.

n3b.speaker: maren
n3b.text: We'll see. I've buried enough people who meant no harm.

n4.speaker: maren
n4.text: The Choir Steps on the eastern ridge are closest to the Core. Bramble Wisps have been swarming the east road since last night. Clear them, and I'll let you go up.

start.speaker: maren
start.text: The wisps are thickest past the last farmhouse on the east road. Strike while they wind up. They telegraph like drunk sailors.

start.speaker: maren
start.text: The Choir Steps are yours to search. Bring me back something more useful than rumours.

start.speaker: maren
start.text: The Core is brighter, and the Quiet Bell is ringing warnings. You've made my life complicated, stranger. Thank you, I think.

start.speaker: maren
start.text: Vael Harrow welcomes travelers who keep the peace. Keep it.

start.speaker: ostin
start.text: Peace to you. "What is silent cannot be broken." Though lately the silence has been very loud.

n2.speaker: ostin
n2.text: Pilgrims say they hear voices in the spray at Silverfall. I'm too old for the climb. Would you go, and tell me honestly what you hear?

yes.speaker: ostin
yes.text: Bless you. Follow the lake road north from the west bank.

no.speaker: ostin
no.text: The falls will wait. They have waited six hundred years.

start.speaker: ostin
start.text: Silverfall lies past the lake. Mind the slippery stones.

start.speaker: ostin
start.text: You're soaked to the bone. And there's something in your eyes. What did you hear?

choices.text: Voices. Singing. And water answering me.

n2.speaker: ostin
n2.text: Then the Resonance answers you. I pray it is mercy and not a test.

n2b.speaker: ostin
n2b.text: Your hands are dripping, child, and the water isn't falling. Don't lie to a priest.

n3.speaker: narrator
n3.text: Cold clarity floods your chest. You can hear Aqua.

start.speaker: ostin
start.text: Whatever you are, I'll pray for you. Even if the Bell would rather I didn't.

start.speaker: toma
start.text: Psst. You're new. New means you don't know the prices yet, which is great for me.

n2.speaker: toma
n2.text: I've got a buyer for Sunpetals, the gold flowers in the meadows south of town. Bring me three and I'll split the profit. Mostly fairly.

why.speaker: toma
why.text: Sixty-forty. Fifty-fifty if you stop asking questions. Deal?

yes.speaker: toma
yes.text: Knew you were smart. Three Sunpetals. Don't eat them, they're gross.

start.speaker: toma
start.text: Sunpetals grow where it's sunny. I know, shocking. South meadows.

start.speaker: toma
start.text: Ooh, look at those. Perfect petals. My buyer will weep.

n2.speaker: toma
n2.text: Here's your cut, and some bread I definitely paid for. Pleasure doing business, partner.

start.speaker: toma
start.text: Partner! If you hear of anything shiny and unguarded, you know where I live. Everywhere.

start.speaker: hesk
start.text: That blade of yours, let me see. Hm. Good steel, but the folding pattern... nobody's forged like that in centuries.

n2.speaker: hesk
n2.text: If you find Riverstone, bring it by sometime. Makes a fine whetstone.

start.speaker: wenna
start.text: You look like you haven't eaten since the Silence. Sit. No? Then take this for the road.

start.speaker: wenna
start.text: Half the town's at my tables arguing about the Core. Best week for business I've had in years.

signs.sign_harrow: VAEL HARROW. Est. 41 AS. Keep the peace of the Concord.
signs.sign_east: East Road. Choir Steps, 1 league. Travelers beware of wisps.
signs.sign_lake: Lake Mirelle and Silverfall. Pilgrims, mind the stones.
signs.sign_forest: Whisperwood. Do not leave the road after dark.
signs.sign_ruins: Carved in an old script, half worn away: "...SEVEN VOICES HELD THE SKY... THE SEVENTH SANG ALONE..."
signs.sign_brazier: Three bowls of old bronze surround a sealed door. The carving shows flames rising into a single star.
signs.sign_overlook: From here the whole Green Frontier is visible: the town, the lake, and the dead Core on the ridge. It isn't quite dead anymore.
